newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Eltin sees higher 2nd half profit.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Eltin sees higher 2nd half profit.

text.p: Mining contractor Eltin Ltd said on Thursday it expected higher second half earnings due to a record order book of A$956 million and projects already underway.

The company said it had substantial work in the surface and underground mining divisions, which was well-spread geographically and included contracts for gold, iron ore, coal nickel and copper mining.
"Preparation for commencement of the new contracts is well underway and, combined with existing work, an improved second half result is forecast," managing director Nick Bowen said.
"Mining contracting revenuue is now forecast to reach A$500 million for the year," Bowen said, with capital expenditure forecast to be more than A$85 million in the current half year.

The company said its 51 percent-owned Salsigne gold mine near Carcassone in France produced 39,464 ounces in the December 1996 half year, with operations improving except for the month of December when the region had high rainfall.
It said it still planned to sell this asset along with its investment in Mali minerals exploration.
Eltin said earlier on Thursday that net profit in the six months to December 31 rose by 128 percent to A$6.33 million while sales rose eight percent to A$248.49 million.
